Alexandra Kulcsár-Horváth

wedding, portrait and lifestyle photographer

Based in Budapest, Alexandra creates natural, honest images that preserve the feeling of the people and moments in front of her camera.

She specialises in wedding photography and relaxed portraits for business, dating profiles and personal memories. Her work also extends to lifestyle stories and pet photography, always with an attentive eye for genuine connection.

Alexandra works calmly and collaboratively, helping clients feel comfortable and confident throughout the shoot. Whether she is documenting a wedding day or creating a portrait in the studio, she focuses on the details that make every story personal.

Alexandra is available for photoshoots in the following genres:

wedding

portrait

lifestyle

business

pet

couples & families
